# Design System Master File

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/pulse-fulfilment/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file.
> If not, strictly follow the rules below.

---

**Project:** Pulse Fulfilment (pulsefulfilment.co.uk)
**Generated:** 2026-10-28 (hand-written from the live site; not generated by `search.py`)
**Category:** B2B services — UK ecommerce order fulfilment / 3PL
**Design Dials:** Variance 5/10 (balanced, editorial) | Motion 3/10 (subtle reveals only) | Density 3/10 (spacious marketing pages)

The site's look is **settled and live**. Use this file to keep new work consistent with it. Do not
run `--design-system` to propose a new palette, font pairing or style for this project.

---

## Global Rules

### Pattern

**Hero-centric + proof + process.** Every landing-style page follows: eyebrow label → serif headline
with one gradient-highlighted word → lead paragraph → two CTAs (gradient "Book a call →" and
ghost "See pricing") → trust strip → sections → gradient CTA panel → footer. Conversion goal is a
booked discovery call; secondary goal is a pricing enquiry.

### Style

**Editorial / refined.** Warm off-white paper, deep navy ink, serif display headlines over a clean
sans UI, pill buttons, soft navy-tinted shadows, one pink→amber gradient used sparingly as the
"pulse" accent. Dark navy panels for feature cards and the footer. No glassmorphism, no neon,
no AI-purple gradients, no stock-photo heroes.

### Color Palette

| Role | Hex | CSS Variable |
|------|-----|--------------|
| Ink (headings, dark sections, footer) | `#131A4A` | `--ink` |
| Ink 2 (lifted navy for panels) | `#232C6B` | `--ink-2` |
| Ink soft (body text, muted) | `#5A618C` | `--ink-soft` |
| Pink (primary accent, gradient start) | `#FF2E7E` | `--pink` |
| Pink deep (accent text, hover, eyebrows) | `#D6115D` | `--pink-deep` |
| Amber (secondary accent, gradient end) | `#FFB627` | `--amber` |
| Amber deep (hover) | `#FF8A2B` | `--amber-deep` |
| Paper (page background) | `#FBFAF8` | `--paper` |
| Paper 2 (tinted section/panel) | `#F2F1F6` | `--paper-2` |
| White (cards) | `#FFFFFF` | `--white` |
| Line (hairline borders) | `#E6E4EE` | `--line` |
| Gradient "pulse" accent | `linear-gradient(100deg, #FF2E7E 0%, #FFB627 100%)` | `--grad` |
| Gradient soft (tinted backgrounds) | `linear-gradient(100deg, #FFE6F0 0%, #FFF3DC 100%)` | `--grad-soft` |

**Color Notes:** Pink/amber are accents, never large fills except the CTA panel and primary
button. Text on paper uses `--ink` or `--ink-soft`; coloured text uses `--pink-deep`, which is the
lightest pink that passes 4.5:1 on `--paper-2` (do not lighten it). On navy panels, body text is
`#C9CDF0` or `#9aa0d8`. Semantic colours: errors use `--pink-deep`; success ticks use `#2ECC8A`.

### Typography

- **Heading Font:** Newsreader (serif, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.005em) — `--headline`
- **UI / Display Font:** Space Grotesk 400–700 (nav, buttons, labels, stats, card titles) — `--display`
- **Body Font:** Manrope 400–800 — `--body`
- **Mood:** Editorial, founder-led, confident, human
- **Google Fonts:** loaded via one `<link>` in every page `<head>` (never `@import`), `display=swap`

| Role | Class / element | Size |
|------|-----------------|------|
| Hero headline | `.h-xl` / `.hero h1` | `clamp(2.6rem, 6.2vw, 5rem)` |
| Section headline | `.h-lg` | `clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 3.4rem)` |
| Sub-headline | `.h-md` | `clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.2rem)` |
| Lead paragraph | `.lead` | `clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.3rem)`, colour `--ink-soft` |
| Eyebrow label | `.eyebrow` | 13–14px, `--pink-deep`, short rule before it; sentence case on the homepage, uppercase tracked elsewhere |
| Body | `body` | 16–17px, line-height 1.6 |

One gradient word per headline at most: `<span class="grad-text">pulse</span>`.

### Spacing Variables

*Density: 3/10 — spacious*

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--gut` | `clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px)` | Horizontal page gutter |
| `--maxw` | `1200px` | `.wrap` content width; `.wrap-wide` is 1360px |
| `.section-pad` | `clamp(64px, 9vw, 130px)` vertical | Every top-level section |
| card padding | 24–32px | `.card`, feature tiles |
| grid gap | 16–24px | Card grids |
| hero CTA gap | 14px | Button rows |

### Radius & Shadows

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--r-sm` | `10px` | Inputs, small tiles |
| `--r` | `16px` | Cards |
| `--r-lg` | `24px` | Panels, cookie banner |
| `--r-xl` | `32px` | Hero visual, CTA panels |
| Pills | `100px` | Buttons, chips, badges |
| `--shadow-sm` | `0 2px 8px rgba(19,26,74,.06)` | Resting cards |
| `--shadow` | `0 14px 40px -18px rgba(19,26,74,.28)` | Hover lift, primary button |
| `--shadow-lg` | `0 40px 90px -40px rgba(19,26,74,.45)` | Hero visual, modals |

Shadows are always navy-tinted (`rgba(19,26,74,…)`), never grey or black.

## Component Specs

### Buttons

```css
/* Primary: gradient pill */
.btn.btn-grad { background: var(--grad); color: #fff; border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 14px 24px; font: 600 15px var(--display);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -10px rgba(225,19,103,.6); }
/* Secondary: ghost pill */
.btn.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
/* Hover: translateY(-2px) + --shadow; arrow glyph (.arr) nudges 4px right */
```

Labels end with an arrow where they lead somewhere: "Book a call →", "See pricing". Minimum
touch target 44px tall. Never more than one gradient button per view.

### Cards

White (`--white`) on paper, `--r` radius, 1px `--line` border, `--shadow-sm`; hover lifts 4px with
`--shadow`. Icon tiles use a soft pink/amber tint square (`--grad-soft`) with a 24px line icon.
Navy variant (`--ink-2` on `--ink` sections) for feature lists and stats.

### Chips / Badges

Pill, 12–13px Space Grotesk 600, uppercase for status badges ("Popular", "Recommended") which use
the gradient; filter chips are white with `--line` border and `--ink` text, active chip is `--ink` fill.

### Forms

Visible labels above fields, 14px bold `--ink`; inputs `--r-sm`, `--line` border, `--paper` fill,
16px text (no zoom on iOS); error state border `--pink-deep` with a message under the field; submit
is the primary gradient button, full width on mobile, shows "Sending…" while in flight, then a
success panel replaces the form. Honeypot field present. Submissions go through `pulseSubmitForm`.

### Navigation

Sticky white header, logo left, six text links, gradient "Book a call" right. Active link in
`--pink-deep`. Below 900px: "Menu" pill opens a drawer listing the same links plus the CTA. Footer:
four columns (brand + address, Explore, Company, Plans) then the nine location links, then
copyright line; footer headings are `<h3>`.

### Motion

Scroll reveal only: `.reveal` → `.in` (opacity + 26px rise, 0.7s, staggered with `.d1–.d3`),
count-up on stats, 0.2s hover transitions. No parallax, no autoplay video, no bounce. Respect
`prefers-reduced-motion` for anything new.

### Icons

Inline SVG line icons (Heroicons/Lucide style, 1.5–2px stroke), tinted `--pink-deep` on tint tiles.
Never emoji as icons. The only flag emoji is the 🇬🇧 in the footer locality line.

### Imagery

No stock photography. Visuals are product-style UI cards (the "live fulfilment feed"), branded
illustrated panels on navy, and partner/integration logos on white tiles. Blog heroes are branded
navy panels with a headline and a single motif. Logos: `assets/logo.png` (wordmark, 500×250) and
`assets/logo-mark.png` (mark, 239×239); never recolour or stretch them.

---

## Anti-patterns (do not)

- Introduce a new accent colour, a purple/blue gradient, or large pink fills
- Use a different serif or swap Newsreader for a sans headline
- Add emoji icons, stock photos, or decorative blobs beyond the hero's two blurred glows
- Add sliders/carousels, autoplaying media, or scroll-jacking
- Place text under 12px, or coloured text lighter than `--pink-deep` on paper
- Remove focus rings; every interactive element must be keyboard reachable
- Put important copy inside images
- Add a third CTA to the hero
- Break the 72-page duplication: any header/footer change must be scripted across all pages

## Pre-delivery checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check-site.py` passes
- [ ] New page has title, description, canonical, og tags, GA4+GTM snippets, sitemap entry
- [ ] Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for text (Lighthouse accessibility ≥ 95)
- [ ] Checked at 390px, 768px and 1440px
- [ ] Reveal animation leaves nothing hidden after 3s
- [ ] Deployed to staging and viewed before production
